description:
One model portfolio's full detail: holdings, overlay legs, event feed,
NAV series, and windowed returns. Returns an error if the book's tier
(e.g. an Elite-only book) is above the caller's own subscription tier.
name: rayana_ai_portfolio

BookEvent.description:
One row of the public event feed — the projection of the diff log, not
the log. ``reason`` has already been rewritten into the fixed public
vocabulary by ``_public_reason``; the stored text never reaches here, and
``source_metric`` (the number behind it) is undeclared on purpose.
BookEvent.title: BookEvent

Contract.description:
The option contract an overlay leg is written on: its identity
(expiry/strike/right, per ``_contract_id`` in strategy/model_portfolios.py)
plus what a reader needs to price it.

Deliberately absent: ``delta`` and ``implied_vol`` — the leg already
publishes ``assignment_prob``, which IS |delta| — and ``iv_rank`` / ``vrp``
/ ``timing_mult``, the overlay's timing provenance, which is selection
mechanism (strategy/premium_overlay.py::contract_spec).
Contract.title: Contract

DistributionSummary.description:
The book's distribution record (docs/distribution_layer.md §5). ``None``
on ``PortfolioMetrics.distribution`` means not a distributing book at all;
present with ``since`` and ``distributions_to_date_pct`` None means it IS
distributing but no session has crossed the seam yet — a real state, and it
renders differently. Nothing here is annualised. Any surface rendering a
distribution or yield figure must render ``sustain_gap_pct`` and
``return_of_capital_pct`` beside it (spec §11, D3).
DistributionSummary.title: DistributionSummary

Holding.description:
One equity (or cash) position in today's snapshot.

``weight_pct`` is the only position quantity that exists — no shares, no
dollars, by construction of the tables themselves (the FIREWALL note on the
model_portfolio_* DDL in data/db.py). ``side`` is 'long' (NULL = long) or
'short', and ``weight_pct`` stays POSITIVE either way.

Deliberately absent, all of which the ``list[dict]`` this replaced shipped:
``rationale`` — engine text that names the selection mechanism and quotes
its live cut-points ("invest composite 72 (BUY); tech 68 / fund 55",
"Donchian breakdown below the 200-SMA; 2N buy-stop $41.80"), i.e. exactly
the disclosure ``_public_events`` rewrites event reasons to prevent, one
table over; ``metrics`` — the per-name selection metrics JSON, whose
publishable aggregate is ``PortfolioMetrics`` below; ``stop_price`` and
``target_price`` — the exit rule's live cut-points; and the row's internal
identity (``id`` / ``portfolio_id`` / ``run_id`` / ``recorded_at``).

``assigned`` / ``effective_basis`` are the one allowlisted lift OUT of that
dropped ``metrics`` block (data/reads.py::_assigned_view), and they are not an
exception to the rule above: an assignment is an OUTCOME the event feed
already publishes in full, not a selection decision. Without them the single
row in the book that the picker did NOT choose arrives indistinguishable from
one it did — a new ticker with ``select_metric: null`` and no basis — which is
the whole of docs/subscriber_followability.md §5.
Holding.title: Holding

NavPoint.description:
One session on the track record. ``nav`` is TOTAL return indexed to 100
at inception and is never restated; ``capital_nav`` is the parallel curve a
holder sees if they take the distributions out (docs/distribution_layer.md).
``distribution_pct`` NULL means the book does not distribute at all — 0.0
means it does and nothing settled this session.
NavPoint.title: NavPoint

NavWindow.description:
MTD / 3M / 6M / 12M / ITD total return. ``covered`` False (with
``return_pct`` None) means the record does not yet reach back past that
window's cutoff — render it as unavailable, never as the ITD number.
NavWindow.title: NavWindow

OverlayLeg.description:
One written CSP / covered-call leg currently open against the core.

A leg carries the SAME ticker as the underlying it is written against and
is sized by NOTIONAL, not book weight — the two must never be summed, which
is why the read layer splits them out of ``holdings`` by ``instrument_type``.

``premium_yield_pct`` and ``assignment_prob`` are 0-1 FRACTIONS, unlike
every other ``_pct`` field in this API (strategy/premium_overlay.py's
``annual_yield`` / ``abs(delta)``) — clients must format them accordingly.
OverlayLeg.title: OverlayLeg

PortfolioMetrics.description:
Book-level aggregates over today's snapshot (data/reads.py's
``_book_metrics``). The income figures are weight-weighted over the book's
TOTAL weight, so an unmeasured name drags the average down rather than being
assumed to yield like its peers.
PortfolioMetrics.title: PortfolioMetrics

PortfolioRegistry.description:
The book's registry row as its detail page sees it: the same
merchandising identity as ``ShelfCard``, plus the parsed construction and
minus the per-caller flags (the detail endpoint's own gate already answered
those).
PortfolioRegistry.title: PortfolioRegistry

PublicConstruction.description:
The book's construction rules, trimmed to what is safe to publish — the
same set ``_PUBLIC_CONSTRUCTION_KEYS`` names in api/routers/portfolios.py,
which stays the enforcing copy (it runs before this model is built).
PublicConstruction.title: PublicConstruction

title: Model portfolio detail
